name: klar
description: Privacy-first job search, ranking, and application toolkit.
author: Klar contributors

scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -s first -n web,desktop "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron desktop/main.mjs"
scripts.desktop:dist:mac-arm64: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac zip --arm64
scripts.desktop:dist:win-x64: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win portable --x64
scripts.desktop:dist:production: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.production.yml --publish never
scripts.qa: node --check public/sw.js && node --check public/theme-bootstrap.js && node model/experiments/build-kaggle-notebook.mjs --check && npm run typecheck && npm run worker:types:check && npm run worker:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run bundle:check && npm run build:desktop && npm run bundle:check && npm run worker:dry-run
